params.body:
Closes #1058

## Why

A single HEAD request to the bucket that did not answer, in `VehicleApiService::addPhoto` ("does this photo name already exist?"), threw `UnableToCheckExistence`. `VehicleApiController::store` caught it and deleted the partner's whole new vehicle. The bucket is intermittently slow; `ProcessImage` already handles the same symptom with `StorageUnavailable::retryOnce` (#988).

## What changes

- `addPhoto` asks that HEAD through `StorageUnavailable::retryOnce`: one more try after a one-second pause.
- A bucket that does not answer twice still fails the upload with nothing half-written, now as a `StorageUnavailable` carrying the real cause (for example `cURL error 28`) instead of the Flysystem wrapper.

## Tests

Two cases added to `ASlowBucketIsNotAMissingPhotoTest`: a photo lands past one slow HEAD (fails without the change), and a bucket that never answers writes no file and no row. `ASlowBucketIsNotAMissingPhotoTest`, `ImportedPhotosWithoutFileTest` and `PhotoRowOnlyWithFileTest` pass (23 tests); PHPStan clean.

Source: Portal mail:37.
params.title: Retry a slow bucket HEAD in the partner API photo upload
